title: Research Assistant
description: Researched TCP keep-alive behavior across operating systems to understand how distributed applications detect silent node and network failures. Built C client-server test software, evaluated failure scenarios, and submitted the findings and implementation to the supervising professor.
highlights: Implemented a C client and server to exercise TCP keep-alive behavior under controlled failure scenarios.
Tested failures by interrupting client and server network connectivity after establishing active connections.
Found that silent server failures could leave clients sending data without receiving a socket failure across multiple Linux distributions.
Documented the results and submitted the test implementation to the supervising professor.
